$schema_note: v1.5.7 098 — sanitized example harness config. Tracked in git under bin/harness/. The LIVE config.json lives at repos/security-test-cases/config.json (gitignored top-level by `.gitignore:25 (repos/)` — it carries local paths). The harness config-loader prefers the live config.json; if absent, falls back to this example file (and may copy it to the live location on first run).

channels.$comment: Per-channel defaults. Operators override per-run via the qpb_harness CLI; this file just seeds reasonable starting values.

paths.$comment: Use repo-relative defaults — NO machine-specific absolute paths in the tracked example. The loader resolves these against the runner-root (typically repos/security-test-cases/).
